text:
Kevin (Sales): Hi team — attaching the vendor risk package for prospect Voltik. Bundle includes: vuln scan export, triage notes, remediation plan draft, and evidence screenshots. Planning to send this to their security reviewer tomorrow AM. @maria_sec can you quick-check the criticals?

Maria (Security): Thanks Kevin. Quick Q: any confirmed RCE/privilege escalation items or mostly info/low? Also share the scanner output link so I can grep CVE IDs.

Kevin (Sales): Mostly medium/low. One medium with public exploit reference (CVE-2024-XXXX) in a 3rd-party library used by the console. Link: https://files.redwood.example/voltik-risk/package-1823456789.zip (uploaded)

ops_bot: File uploaded by kevin_sales: package-1823456789.zip (45MB) :package:

Maria (Security): Downloading now. From quick skim: the CVE you flagged has an exploit but requires authenticated local access. Recommend we mark it medium and note mitigations: upgrade lib to 2.7.1 or apply ACLs.

Jane (Engineering): I pulled the triage notes. Backend team wrote a patch branch for the lib bump, test pass on staging. Patch ID: git://repo/repo/patches/voltik-libfix-2.7.1. Can schedule hotfix deploy in next maintenance window (2 business days).

Kevin (Sales): Great. Draft remediation timeline below — feel free to edit. Planning to include this in the customer-facing package.

Maria (Security): Looks reasonable. Please also include temporary compensating control (network ACL) and a note that we can provide signed patch artifact for their audit.

Kevin (Sales): Updated timeline (final):
```
Day 0 (today): share full package + triage summary with Voltik security team
Day 1: security ack & confirm priority; apply network ACL workaround (if requested)
Day 2-3: engineering applies library upgrade on staging, run integration tests
Day 4: schedule hotfix deploy to canary region, smoke test
Day 5: full rollout and deliver signed artifacts + remediation verification report
```

Tim (Account Exec): Can we also include a short note on SLA for Dedicated customers and offer a tech review call? Voltik asked about timelines and legal signoff.

Kevin (Sales): Yes — I'll add a one-paragraph SLA summary and propose a 30-min tech deep-dive tomorrow at 10am PT.

Maria (Security): FYI I added a short blurb for the package: "No active exploited criticals found; one medium with public exploit requiring authenticated access. Remediation: upgrade to lib v2.7.1 and/or apply network ACLs. Evidence: vuln-scan.csv and exploit-proof-of-concept-screenshot.png included."

Jane (Engineering): I'll prepare the signed artifact and a short runbook for their ops team (how to validate the fix). ETA EOD.

Kevin (Sales): Perfect. I'll send the package + timeline to Voltik and loop back with their security lead. Tagging @maria_sec and @jane_engineering in the outbound so they get it. :thumbsup:

Maria (Security): Approved to send from my side. Add me on the email and I'll jump on the call if needed.

ops_bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up with Voltik security in 48 hours (automated)

Kevin (Sales): Thanks everyone. Closing thread once Voltik confirms receipt.
